name: ziztu-drama-writer
description: Writes binge-worthy AI micro drama series with a hook and a cliffhanger in every episode, and produces them as video on Ziztu through the Ziztu connector. A second skill layers AI images and video in depth and fixes flat frames.

interface.shortDescription: Write and make binge-worthy AI micro dramas
interface.longDescription: Turns an idea into a vertical micro drama series where every 60 to 120 second episode opens on a hook, pays something off and ends on a cliffhanger: pitches and titles, a series bible with consistent characters, a season grid, Fountain episode scripts and punch-ups, then the episodes are made as video on Ziztu (shot plan, prices, frames, clips, music, export). A second skill, Cinematic Depth, writes a soft foreground, a sharp subject and a hazy background into image and video prompts and fixes flat frames.
defaultPrompt: Use $ziztu-micro-drama to pitch three micro drama series and write the bible for the best one.
Use $ziztu-micro-drama to write episodes 1 to 3 of my series with a cliffhanger in each.
Use $ziztu-micro-drama to make episode 1 on Ziztu. Show me every price before you spend.
Use $ziztu-cinematic-depth to rewrite my shot prompt so it has a soft foreground, a sharp subject and a hazy background.
